Title: Spoon Bread
Ingredients:
2 eggs
1-1/2 c (6oz) mild cheddar, divided
1 can (8oz) cream style corn
1 c. sour cream
6 Tbsp butter, melted
Instructions:
Beat eggs in a medium bowl.
Add the cheese, corn, sour cream and melted butter, mixing thoroughly.
Pour into a greased 2 qt. baking dish.
Bake at 350 for 45 minutes, until the centre is set.

Title: Pancakes
Ingredients:
2 cups plain flour
2 tbsp caster sugar
1 egg
300 ml milk
A pinch of salt
Instructions:
Whisk the dry ingredients together.
Beat in the egg and milk until smooth.
Fry in a little butter until golden on both sides.
